description: Commit the saved resolutions for a PR's conflicts ON THE PR HEAD as a two-parent merge commit (old head, base tip) — never on the base branch — moved through the push gates so CI runs on it before anything merges. Every unresolved file needs a draft (gluecron_resolve_pr_conflict) or an entry in `resolutions`; files the merge rules settle are settled automatically. Both shas are compare-and-swapped: a branch that moved since is refused with nothing changed. The commit carries `Conflict-Resolution:` trailers; a gluecron[bot] comment records it. Requires write access and 'repo' scope.

message.description: Optional subject line (default: Merge branch '<base>' into <head>)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

resolutions.description: Optional explicit list instead of the saved drafts: [{path, how: manual | choice | ai | ai-edited | keep-mine | keep-main, content?}] — content is required unless how is keep-mine / keep-main

name: gluecron_commit_pr_conflict_resolution
